title: Fungi and mushrooms
examples: Are mushrooms actually plants or something else?
How do fungi get their food?
What is the difference between mold and mushrooms?

explain.say: Today we are learning about fungi, which are a group of organisms.

items: Fungi are a separate kingdom of life.
They are not classified as plants.
They have different structures from plants.

explain.say: Fungi reproduce using tiny structures called spores.
Many fungi act as decomposers in nature's cycle.
Yeast is a type of fungus often used in baking bread.
In real life, fungi help break down fallen leaves in a forest.
A common mistake is thinking all fungi are visible mushrooms.

faq.a: No, mushrooms are not plants. They belong to their own group of organisms called fungi.
asks: Are mushrooms part of the plant kingdom?

faq.q: How do fungi get their energy?
faq.a: Fungi get energy by breaking down dead or living organic matter around them. This process is called decomposition.
asks: Do they eat plants or animals?

faq.q: What are spores and how do they help fungi?
faq.a: Spores are tiny reproductive units that fungi release into the air. When they land somewhere suitable, they can grow into a new fungus.
asks: What is the function of spores?

faq.q: What is the role of decomposers in an ecosystem?
faq.a: Decomposers break down dead organisms, returning vital nutrients to the soil for new life to use.
asks: Why are fungi important to the soil?

faq.q: What is yeast and where is it found?
faq.a: Yeast is a single-celled fungus often found naturally on fruits and grains. We use it to make bread rise.
asks: Is yeast a type of mold?
What does yeast do in baking?

facts: Fungi are classified in their own kingdom, separate from plants and animals.
Fungi obtain nutrients by absorbing them from their surroundings.
Spores are the primary method by which many fungi reproduce.
Decomposers like fungi are vital for nutrient cycling in ecosystems.

quiz.say: Which group of organisms includes mushrooms and molds?
quiz.why: Fungi is the correct kingdom that includes mushrooms and molds.

wrong.0: Bacteria are a different group, though they are also decomposers.
wrong.2: Plants make their own food using sunlight, which fungi cannot do.
wrong.3: Animals must eat other organisms, while fungi absorb nutrients.

quiz.say: What is the main function of fungi in a forest?
quiz.why: Fungi act as decomposers, breaking down dead plant and animal matter.

wrong.0: Pollination is usually done by insects or wind, not the main role of fungi.
wrong.1: While fungi respire, their key ecological role here is decomposition.
wrong.3: Photosynthesis is the process plants use to make food with light.

quiz.say: If a baker uses yeast, what process is occurring?
quiz.why: Yeast undergoes fermentation, producing gas that makes bread rise.

wrong.0: Absorption is taking something in, but fermentation is the chemical process.
wrong.2: Digestion happens inside a living organism's body.
wrong.3: Germination is when a seed starts to sprout, not what yeast does.
